messages.author: 9bb8c7eb3016ed27
messages.subject: Status of rstan and CRAN
parts:
Dear all,

I am developing an R package with a set of ggraphical tools for analyzing
Markov Chain Monte Carlo simulations from Bayesian inference [1]

I have added the functionality to import data from rstan (stanfit objects),
but since rstan is not yet in CRAN I am having trouble passing the checks
to upload the package to CRAN.

The package works when 'rstan' is under 'suggested', but it can't be there
because it is not in CRAN.

So either I remove temporarily the functionality to manage rstan objects
or I manage to keep it.

In any case: what is the roadmap for including rstan into CRAN? Or,
alternatively, how can I still use rstan:::extract without having rstan
under 'suggested'?

Best,


[1] ggmcmc http://xavier-fim.net/packages/ggmcmc

--
- Xavier -

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Status of rstan and CRAN
parts:
On Saturday, December 8, 2012 3:57:57 AM UTC-5, X FiM wrote:
In any case: what is the roadmap for including rstan into CRAN? Or,
alternatively, how can I still use rstan:::extract without having rstan
under 'suggested'?

I would say that you can't count on RStan being on CRAN any time soon. The attached patch avoids calling rstan:::extract directly by instead calling as.array (which in turn will call rstan:::extract if RStan is loaded) but as.array is hardcoded to inc_warmup = FALSE. Then I think you can drop rstan from suggests in DESCRIPTION, even though it is somewhat supported. But when I did R CMD check on it, I got an unrelated error in the examples.

Ben
